title: Wire functional replay into release and provenance gate
purpose: Make functional capability replay part of release/provenance promotion so new functionality cannot bypass distro gates.
scope: Update build-release or successor gate to run functional replay.
Record capability matrix hash, replay result hash, fixture inventory hash, and command versions.
Classify replay blockers into remediation-required or rollout-blocked.
Keep generated release artifacts ignored unless intentionally published.
implementation_steps: Add functional replay command invocation to release gate or document a successor gate.
Add provenance fields for capability matrix and replay evidence hashes.
Add blocker classification for functional failures.
Record evidence from a dry run.
acceptance_criteria: Release gate fails or blocks promotion when functional replay fails.
Provenance includes matrix and replay hashes.
Generated private or local material remains ignored.
QEMU smoke remains separately visible when promotion requires it.
failure_modes: Release gate ignores functional replay failures.
Gate depends on private signing material for local functional validation.

blocked_until: Release gate records functional replay evidence.
